purpose: Close Gate 14 in a genuinely disposable Windows profile without treating the existing BAXY profile as clean.
preconditions: The final product tree is frozen.
A predecessor and a distinct candidate Baxy.Setup.exe are both attested for the intended lifecycle campaign.
The disposable account name and SID do not already exist.
No BAXY process owned by the campaign is running.
No physical wake or voice validation is in flight.
The exact evidence output under artifacts/setup does not already exist.
plannedProcedure: Generate a cryptographically random credential in memory; never write it to a file, log, artifact or command line.
With one elevated local action, create an expiring standard local account that is not a member of Administrators.
Record and bind the new account SID, then reject any name or SID mismatch before later cleanup.
Use Start-Process with -Credential and -LoadUserProfile to run a harmless alternate-profile probe before Gate 14.
Require the probe to prove the alternate identity, bound SID, distinct HKCU hive, distinct LOCALAPPDATA, pristine BAXY paths and the current interactive session.
Require a visible disposable-account window probe to open and close normally before allowing the destructive lifecycle gate.
Run Gate 14 under the alternate credential with the exact predecessor, candidate, evidence path and -ConfirmDisposableProfile.
Accept only a passed Gate 14 receipt proving install, first visible launch, update, rollback, keep-data uninstall, reinstall, purge uninstall and zero residual BAXY state.
After all disposable-account processes exit, verify the exact bound name and SID again, delete only that account and its exact profile, and verify both are absent.
failurePolicy: Do not run Gate 14 if the alternate-profile or visible-window probe fails.
Do not reinterpret the current user profile as disposable.
Do not weaken Gate 14 or redirect its evidence outside artifacts/setup.
Do not delete an account or profile when the exact preregistered name and SID cannot both be proven.
On any lifecycle failure, preserve the Gate 14 receipt and reconcile only the campaign-owned disposable profile before retrying.
